description: Retrieval regression baseline for test_papers/attention.pdf (Vaswani et al., 'Attention Is All You Need'). Each expected_page is 0-indexed and was verified by hand: the question's answer is actually present in a chunk on that page. This tests retrieval recall, not answer correctness -- it will catch 'the right passage stopped showing up' regressions in chunking/embedding.
